newsitem.title: USA: Golf Technology Nov orders set record.
newsitem.headline: Golf Technology Nov orders set record.

text.p: Golf Technology Holding Inc said its line of Snake Eyes Golf Clubs achieved a company record for sales orders of 5,155 clubs in November.
"Public acceptance of our Tour quality Snake Eyes' products is rising rapidly," chairman Ernie Vadersen said. "We took forward to a very positive 1997."

Snake Eyes designs and manufactures an expanding line of golf clubs, which currently includes a series of seven scoring system wedges; three drivers with three lofts and proprietary metallurgy; and seven basic design putters with variations of classic shapes.
